title: Strange SmallBall
dek: Frog racing leagues, a trainer that whispered at night, a will for your teams, and two Deluxe Trainers open at once. The side of SmallBall that never made the Home Plate News.
stats: for one prank to pay off
business email signed with a SmallBall name

chapters.title: Been in SmallBall too long when…
chapters.text: DidleySquat sends a quote to a business client and signs it with his SmallBall username, job title and all.

chapters.title: The SmallBall will
chapters.text: Issued-Away asks who you'd leave your teams to if you had to leave forever. The forum starts writing wills: dynasties to best friends, DT teams split among clanmates, master passwords to the one person you trust.
quotes: I'd probably give the Commish a kiss on the cheek.
All my stuff is being buried with me. None of you deserve it.

chapters.title: SmallFrog
chapters.text: solipsta posts a link to a frog racing game: you feed, train and entertain your frog, then it races. The forum goes all in. Beaner founds the SB Frog Society in the Stumpy Creek region, and race reports start arriving in the frogs' own voices. Possibly where "frogging" comes from.
quotes: Last thing I needed was another internet addiction

chapters.title: The DT is talking to me
chapters.text: ivy is training in the Deluxe Trainer when she hears it: "Swing batter-batter." Every two or three minutes. Her son hears it too. It turns out to be her brother, finally paying her back for something from when he was five.
quotes: It took him 20 years to get me back.

chapters.title: Coolest SmallBall Player Name Awards
chapters.text: ALT holds an awards show for player names, with a good feeling as the only prize. Nominees include a full team named after a movie cast, the Lazy Boyz (whose first baseman is a snot-nosed kid), and the unbeatable Feces Flinging Monkeys.

chapters.title: Total chaos and anarchy
chapters.text: The_Safo opens two Deluxe Trainers on one PC and the error message never comes. Slip'N'Sliders finds the trick the next day. chspogo starts planning twelve windows at once, one player each, and redbirds33 worries they'll crash the server and end SmallBall for good.
quotes: IT'S TOTAL CHAOS AND ANARCHY IN SB LAND.

chapters.title: Myth or reality?
chapters.text: West Coast asks a simple question: do you lose more skill the more games you play? The answers split three ways. Myth, says bailey. Only the pitchers, says mlthmp. True, says SB_Knights, and the more you play the more you lose.
